projects.title: Nirdesh AI
projects.shortDescription: Ask questions, manage todos, search the web — all by voice. An instrumented multilingual voice agent featuring real-time STT, LangGraph agent, streaming TTS, and local VAD.
projects.overview: Nirdesh AI is an instrumented multilingual voice agent built as a sandwich architecture: streaming speech-to-text feeds a LangGraph-backed text agent, then streaming text-to-speech returns PCM audio to the browser.

keyFeatures.name: Multilingual Voice Loop
keyFeatures.description: Powered by Saaras v3 STT, sarvam-105b LLM, and Bulbul v3 TTS.
keyFeatures.detail: Delivers real-time spoken interactions across multiple languages.

keyFeatures.name: Silero ONNX VAD
keyFeatures.description: Local 32 ms frames, speech pre-roll, 500 ms endpointing, and silence gating.
keyFeatures.detail: Filters background noise and manages precise voice activity detection.

keyFeatures.name: Barge-in Control
keyFeatures.description: Cancels generation, tears down active TTS socket, flushes playback, and truncates history.
keyFeatures.detail: Ensures responsive interruption when user speaks during assistant audio playback.

keyFeatures.name: LangChain Tools
keyFeatures.description: Server-side Exa web search and browser-proxied local todo management.
keyFeatures.detail: Empowers voice agent to perform web queries and manage client state.

keyFeatures.name: Billing & Wallet
keyFeatures.description: Paise-denominated wallet with per-second voice session billing.
keyFeatures.detail: Enforces real-time balance tracking, warnings, and session cutoff.

projects.title: Lumina
projects.shortDescription: An AI search agent powered by a custom agent loop that intelligently decides when to use tools like Google/web search to gather real-time information.
projects.overview: Lumina is a production-style AI search assistant — tool-calling agent, live web search, cited markdown answers, streaming UI. The agent is tool-first: the LLM decides when to search with no forced pre-search on every query.

keyFeatures.name: Tool-First Agent Loop
keyFeatures.description: The LLM decides when to search, eliminating unnecessary pre-searches.
keyFeatures.detail: Iteratively alternates between LLM reasoning and external tools until producing grounded responses.

keyFeatures.name: Live Web Search
keyFeatures.description: Powered by Tavily API with basic and advanced depth modes.
keyFeatures.detail: Supports fast query searches and deep research modes.

keyFeatures.name: Streamed, Cited Answers
keyFeatures.description: NDJSON streaming with inline citations tied to real web sources.
keyFeatures.detail: Renders markdown responses with click-through source links.

keyFeatures.name: Multi-Model Routing
keyFeatures.description: Swap between GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, and Gemini 2.5 Flash via OpenRouter.
keyFeatures.detail: Dynamic model selection for tailored reasoning capabilities.

keyFeatures.name: Auth & Credit Limits
keyFeatures.description: Supabase JWT authentication paired with server-side credit gates.
keyFeatures.detail: Tracks per-user queries and enforces access boundaries.

projects.title: Drug Discovery
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise-grade multi-agent AI system for drug-target prioritisation across DepMap, Open Targets, Pharos, and Europe PMC.
projects.overview: Drug Discovery Agent automates end-to-end drug-target prioritisation with a LangGraph orchestrator, MCP-connected biomedical databases, deterministic scoring, and human-in-the-loop review gates.

keyFeatures.name: LangGraph Pipeline
keyFeatures.description: Planning, parallel collection, normalisation, scoring, evidence graphs, and synthesis.
keyFeatures.detail: Stateful DAG with checkpointing and resumability for reproducible research runs.

keyFeatures.name: MCP Data Layer
keyFeatures.description: Parallel queries across DepMap, Pharos, Open Targets, and Europe PMC.
keyFeatures.detail: Standardised tool protocol decouples source connectors from pipeline logic.

keyFeatures.name: Deterministic Scoring
keyFeatures.description: Weighted multi-source druggability scores with conflict detection.
keyFeatures.detail: Produces tiered recommendations with full provenance tracing.

keyFeatures.name: Human-in-the-Loop
keyFeatures.description: Optional plan approval and review gates before dossier acceptance.
keyFeatures.detail: Researchers can approve, modify, or request more evidence.

keyFeatures.name: Research Workbench
keyFeatures.description: FastAPI + Next.js UI with live SSE progress and follow-up Q&A.
keyFeatures.detail: Evidence carousel, conflict visualisation, and compare mode for gene dossiers.

projects.title: ExploitDB RAG
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered exploit intelligence system with RAG over 46,000+ ExploitDB entries, intent-aware retrieval, and hallucination validation.
projects.overview: ExploitDB RAG is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation assistant for searching and analyzing exploits from ExploitDB with intent-aware retrieval, hybrid semantic search, and response validation.

keyFeatures.name: Exploit Intelligence
keyFeatures.description: Search 46K+ ExploitDB entries by CVE, software, or natural language.
keyFeatures.detail: Indexes the full ExploitDB corpus for fast exploit discovery.

keyFeatures.name: Intent-Aware Retrieval
keyFeatures.description: Classifies queries and extracts security entities for routing.
keyFeatures.detail: Chooses exact CVE match or semantic similarity based on intent.

keyFeatures.name: Hybrid Search
keyFeatures.description: ChromaDB vector search with HuggingFace embeddings.
keyFeatures.detail: Combines keyword precision with semantic recall.

keyFeatures.name: Hallucination Validation
keyFeatures.description: Verifies LLM answers against retrieved source documents.
keyFeatures.detail: Keeps generated exploit analysis grounded in real entries.

keyFeatures.name: Exploit Customization
keyFeatures.description: Adapts retrieved exploit code to specified target environments.
keyFeatures.detail: Uses structured prompts to tailor payloads for OS and stack context.

projects.title: Wealth
projects.shortDescription: A comprehensive financial management solution that harnesses AI to simplify tracking income and expenses across multiple accounts.
projects.overview: Wealth is a comprehensive financial management solution that harnesses AI to simplify tracking income and expenses across multiple accounts. With features like smart categorization, receipt scanning, recurring transaction management, email alerts, and detailed financial analysis, Wealth delivers personalized monthly reports to help users gain control over their finances and make informed decisions.

keyFeatures.name: Multi-Account Tracking
keyFeatures.description: Aggregates income and expenses from various bank accounts in real time.
keyFeatures.detail: Users get a unified view of their financial status without manual input

keyFeatures.name: Smart Categorization
keyFeatures.description: AI automatically sorts transactions into categories like groceries or utilities.
keyFeatures.detail: It learns user spending habits to improve accuracy over time.

keyFeatures.name: AI Receipt Scanning
keyFeatures.description: Scans receipts via smartphone camera, extracting details like amount and vendor.
keyFeatures.detail: Instantly logs expenses with minimal effort, reducing manual entry errors.

keyFeatures.name: Recurring Transaction Management
keyFeatures.description: Detects and manages subscriptions or regular payments automatically.
keyFeatures.detail: Users can edit or cancel recurring expenses directly within the platform.

keyFeatures.name: Email Alerts
keyFeatures.description: Sends real-time notifications for large transactions, due dates, or budget limits.
keyFeatures.detail: Keeps users proactive and aware of their financial activity.

keyFeatures.name: Financial Analysis
keyFeatures.description: Analyzes spending patterns and income trends with interactive charts.
keyFeatures.detail: Highlights areas for savings and tracks financial health over time.

keyFeatures.name: Personalized Monthly Reports
keyFeatures.description: Generates tailored reports summarizing income, expenses, and savings.
keyFeatures.detail: Provides actionable insights to help users make informed financial decisions.

projects.title: Crime Alert
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack application built with Next.js 14 for anonymous crime reporting with AI-powered features and location mapping.
projects.overview: Crime alert is a full-stack application built with Next.js 14, a powerful React framework that supports server-side rendering, static site generation, and incremental static regeneration. The platform prioritizes user anonymity and security, integrating Google's Gemini AI to assist with incident reporting, Mapbox for location-based features, and modern web technologies like TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, NextAuth, and Prisma ORM. SafeReport offers a seamless, responsive interface that works across all devices, making it accessible and efficient for reporting incidents securely.

keyFeatures.name: AI-Powered Reporting
keyFeatures.description: Google's Gemini AI analyzes input and suggests detailed, structured incident descriptions.
keyFeatures.detail: This reduces user effort and ensures reports are clear and actionable.

keyFeatures.name: Full Anonymity
keyFeatures.description: No personal data is collected, allowing users to report with complete privacy.
keyFeatures.detail: Next.js server-side logic ensures submissions remain untraceable to individuals.

keyFeatures.name: Location Mapping
keyFeatures.description: Mapbox integration offers interactive maps for precise incident location tagging.
keyFeatures.detail: Users can search and pin locations, enhancing report accuracy and usefulness

keyFeatures.name: Secure Authentication
keyFeatures.description: NextAuth provides robust OAuth-based login for admin users only.
keyFeatures.detail: This keeps the platform secure while preserving anonymity for reporters

keyFeatures.name: Responsive Design
keyFeatures.description: Tailwind CSS powers a mobile-first, adaptive UI for all screen sizes.
keyFeatures.detail: Cross-device compatibility ensures accessibility anytime, anywhere.

keyFeatures.name: Data Safety
keyFeatures.description: Prisma ORM encrypts and manages report data in a secure database.
keyFeatures.detail: Type-safe queries and schema design protect sensitive information effectively.

keyFeatures.name: Real-Time Processing
keyFeatures.description: Next.js 14 API routes process submissions instantly with zero downtime.
keyFeatures.detail: Server-side rendering optimizes speed and reliability for every report.

projects.mission: Crime alert's mission is to create a safer world by providing a secure, anonymous platform for reporting incidents. By leveraging AI and modern web technologies, we aim to empower individuals to speak up without fear, fostering transparency and accountability in communities.
projects.impact: Crime alert has the potential to transform how incidents are reported and addressed. By offering a secure, anonymous platform, it encourages more people to come forward, increasing the volume and quality of reported data. This can lead to better crime prevention, faster response times, and improved community safety. The integration of AI simplifies the reporting process, making it more inclusive and user-friendly, while the focus on security ensures trust in the platform. Ultimately, SafeReport aims to create a ripple effect of positive change, where technology-driven transparency leads to safer, more connected communities.

projects.title: Yoom
projects.shortDescription: A modern Zoom clone crafted with Next.js and TypeScript, delivering a robust video conferencing experience.
projects.overview: Yoom is a modern Zoom clone crafted with Next.js and TypeScript, delivering a robust video conferencing experience. With real-time chat, responsive design, and extensive meeting controls. Authenticated via Clerk for secure access, it integrates social sign-on and traditional login methods, ensuring an intuitive and reliable platform for personal and professional use.

keyFeatures.name: Video Conferencing Core
keyFeatures.description: Hosts high-quality video calls with low latency using WebRTC.
keyFeatures.detail: Supports multiple participants with smooth audio and video synchronization.

keyFeatures.name: Secure Authentication
keyFeatures.description: Clerk enables social sign-on (e.g., Google) and email/password logins.
keyFeatures.detail: Ensures user data privacy with secure session management and access control.

keyFeatures.name: Real-Time Chat
keyFeatures.description: Offers in-meeting text chat for instant communication during calls.
keyFeatures.detail: Messages sync seamlessly across devices with Next.js server-side capabilities.

keyFeatures.name: Responsive Design
keyFeatures.description: Built with shadcn, adapts flawlessly to desktops, tablets, and mobiles.
keyFeatures.detail: Provides a consistent, user-friendly experience across all screen sizes.

keyFeatures.name: Meeting Recording
keyFeatures.description: Allows hosts to record sessions with a single click for later review.
keyFeatures.detail: Stores recordings securely, accessible only to authorized users

keyFeatures.name: Screen Sharing
keyFeatures.description: Enables sharing of full screens or specific apps during meetings.
keyFeatures.detail: Enhances collaboration with smooth, high-resolution streaming.

keyFeatures.name: Participant Management
keyFeatures.description: Offers controls like mute, kick, or assign host privileges to attendees.
keyFeatures.detail: Empowers meeting organizers to maintain order and engagement effortlessly.

projects.title: Klimate
projects.shortDescription: A comprehensive weather application that automatically detects your location and provides real-time weather data with 24-hour forecasts.
projects.overview: Klimate is a powerful weather application that combines geolocation technology with real-time weather APIs to deliver accurate, location-based weather information. With features like automatic location detection, 24-hour forecasts, graphical temperature visualization, and city search capabilities, Klimate provides users with all the weather information they need in an intuitive, cross-platform interface.

keyFeatures.name: Current Location Weather
keyFeatures.description: Automatically detects and displays weather for your exact location.
keyFeatures.detail: Uses geolocation to deliver real-time temperature, humidity, and conditions.

keyFeatures.name: 24-Hour Forecast
keyFeatures.description: Provides a detailed forecast for the next day with hourly updates.
keyFeatures.detail: Ensures users can plan ahead with confidence based on reliable data.

keyFeatures.name: Graphical Temperature View
keyFeatures.description: Visualizes the next 24 hours' temperature in an interactive graph.
keyFeatures.detail: Offers a clear, at-a-glance understanding of daily temperature trends

keyFeatures.name: City Weather Search
keyFeatures.description: Allows users to check weather for any city worldwide instantly.
keyFeatures.detail: Supports quick searches with predictive text for ease of use.

keyFeatures.name: Cross-Platform Support
keyFeatures.description: Runs smoothly on iOS, Android, web, and desktop environments.
keyFeatures.detail: Syncs data across devices for a consistent experience anywhere.

keyFeatures.name: Real-Time Updates
keyFeatures.description: Fetches the latest weather data as conditions change.
keyFeatures.detail: Keeps users informed with minimal delay using efficient API integration.

keyFeatures.name: Customizable Interface
keyFeatures.description: Lets users adjust themes and units (e.g., Celsius or Fahrenheit).
keyFeatures.detail: Enhances usability by tailoring the app to personal preferences.

projects.mission: Klimate's mission is to provide accurate, real-time weather information to users worldwide, helping them make informed decisions about their daily activities. By combining cutting-edge geolocation technology with reliable weather APIs, we aim to deliver a seamless weather experience across all platforms.
projects.impact: Klimate empowers users to stay prepared for weather changes with accurate forecasts and real-time updates. The intuitive interface and cross-platform support make weather information accessible to everyone, while the graphical visualizations help users quickly understand temperature trends and plan their day accordingly.

projects.title: Apple Website
projects.shortDescription: A visually stunning recreation of Apple's iPhone 15 Pro landing page with seamless animations and interactive 3D models.
projects.overview: Apple Website is a visually stunning recreation of Apple's iPhone 15 Pro landing page, developed using React.js, Three.js, and GSAP. Featuring seamless animations, interactive 3D models via React Three Fiber, a custom video carousel, and full responsiveness, this project showcases advanced web technologies to deliver a premium, Apple-inspired experience.

keyFeatures.name: Dynamic 3D Models
keyFeatures.description: Three.js and React Three Fiber render interactive iPhone 15 Pro models.
keyFeatures.detail: Users can rotate and explore the device in real-time with smooth performance.

keyFeatures.name: GSAP Animations
keyFeatures.description: GSAP powers fluid transitions and scroll-triggered effects throughout the site.
keyFeatures.detail: Enhances storytelling with cinematic reveals and engaging motion.

keyFeatures.name: Video Carousel
keyFeatures.description: A custom GSAP-driven carousel showcases product videos seamlessly.
keyFeatures.detail: Auto-plays and loops with intuitive navigation for an immersive feel.

keyFeatures.name: Full Responsiveness
keyFeatures.description: Adapts perfectly to all screen sizes, from mobile to desktop.
keyFeatures.detail: Maintains Apple's signature polish across devices with React.js optimization.

keyFeatures.name: Interactive UI
keyFeatures.description: Clickable elements and hover effects elevate user engagement.
keyFeatures.detail: Built with React.js for a fast, component-driven interface.

keyFeatures.name: Optimized Performance
keyFeatures.description: Leverages React's virtual DOM and Three.js efficiency for quick load times.
keyFeatures.detail: Ensures a lag-free experience even with complex animations and 3D rendering.

keyFeatures.name: Modern Design Fidelity
keyFeatures.description: Replicates Apple's minimalist aesthetic with precise typography and layout.
keyFeatures.detail: Uses CSS and GSAP to mirror the premium look and feel of the original site.

projects.mission: Apple Website's mission is to demonstrate the power of modern web technologies in recreating a world-class user experience. We aim to inspire developers and Apple fans alike by blending creativity with cutting-edge tools like React.js, Three.js, and GSAP.
projects.impact: This project showcases how React.js, Three.js, and GSAP can elevate web design, potentially influencing how developers approach interactive, high-fidelity sites. By offering insights into its implementation, it empowers the community to build sophisticated, responsive experiences that rival industry leaders like Apple.
